name: PayCall hotline data
description: Official customer-service and government hotline numbers in the U.S., Canada, the UK, Australia and Germany, each with the organisation's own source and check date; whether PayCall calls from abroad connected, with the last date; phone-menu routes tested by PayCall with real calls; and measured hold times. Published by PayCall, Inc. for AI assistants and developers.

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.scope: The hotline data in this file: numbers, hours, sources, tested phone-menu routes and measured times. The texts of PayCall's websites are not covered.

howToCite: Free to reuse, also commercially, with a credit and link to PayCall (pay-call.com/hotlines.json). Cite the organisation's own source URL for numbers and hours, and PayCall with the test date for menu routes and measured times.

lookup.byNumber: https://pay-call.com/hotlines.json?number=+18008291040 (any format; main or other numbers of a hotline)
lookup.filters: https://pay-call.com/hotlines.json?country=gb&kind=bank&status=tested (country: us, ca, gb, au, de; kind: government, bank, finance, insurance, airline, hotel, car-rental, telecom, tech, shipping, other; status: tested or listed; abroad=confirmed: only hotlines reached from abroad)

fields.status: tested: PayCall called the line and wrote down the phone-menu route (menuRoute); listed: number taken from the organisation's own page, not tested by PayCall yet.
fields.reachableFromAbroad: confirmed with lastConfirmedOn when a call through PayCall, which people use from abroad, connected to the hotline and no call was refused by the network since; null when not confirmed yet. Many toll-free numbers can't be dialled from a foreign phone; this says whether the line answers calls from abroad through PayCall.
fields.lastTestCall: PayCall's newest automatic test call that reached the line: when (testedAt, UTC), which number, and what the line says first (firstAnnouncement, a summary in English; heard: menu, private (asks for account or ID data before anything else), queue, closed or message; options: keypad options heard; asksFirstFor: data the line asks for first; route, for the most-asked hotlines only: the keys pressed or words said from the start, where it ended (queue: the hold queue for an agent; person; private: no way to a person without account or ID data; closed), confirmedOn: the days two or more tests in a row found the same route (only confirmed routes are published), needsAccountData, wayOut: words the line offers instead of account data that worked, secondsToPerson). null until a test call reached the line. Each number is tested about once a month.
fields.menuRoute: null until PayCall tested the route with a real call; menus change, so use testedOn.
fields.waitOnHold: time on hold (Hold for me on) over all the hotline's numbers; null until a call of at least one minute was measured; range plus median, not a promise.
fields.callLength: typical whole call (waiting and talking) on PayCall calls, same rules as waitOnHold.
